mixed-storybook.model: a mixed Twig, React, and custom-element Storybook

notes.concurrently: Kept because Whisk develop runs concurrent Vite and Storybook npm scripts from the hoisted binary.
notes.vite: Kept because Whisk build, vite, and develop call the hoisted Vite binary with Core's shared Vite config.
notes.storybook: Kept because Whisk storybook, storybook-build, and develop call the hoisted Storybook binary with Core's shared config.
notes.@storybook/addon-a11y: Kept because Core's Storybook config supplies the a11y addon used by Whisk Storybook scripts.
notes.@storybook/addon-links: Kept because Core's Storybook config supplies the links addon used by Whisk Storybook scripts.
notes.@storybook/addon-themes: Kept because Core's Storybook config supplies the themes addon used by Whisk Storybook scripts.
notes.@storybook/react: Kept because Core's Storybook runtime uses React stories under Whisk Storybook scripts.
notes.@storybook/react-vite: Kept because Core's Storybook config uses the React/Vite framework for Whisk Storybook scripts.
notes.eslint: Kept because Whisk lint-js calls the hoisted ESLint binary with Core's shared config.
notes.@eslint/js: Kept because Core's ESLint flat config imports the recommended ESLint rules for Whisk lint-js.
notes.eslint-config-prettier: Kept because Core's ESLint Prettier integration requires the config during Whisk lint-js.
notes.eslint-plugin-import: Kept because Core's ESLint config imports the module rules used by Whisk lint-js.
notes.eslint-plugin-jest: Kept because Core keeps Jest lint support available to generated-theme lint-js workflows.
notes.eslint-plugin-prettier: Kept because Core's ESLint config imports Prettier recommendations for Whisk lint-js.
notes.eslint-plugin-security: Kept because Core's ESLint config imports security rules used by Whisk lint-js.
notes.eslint-plugin-storybook: Kept because Core keeps Storybook lint support available to generated-theme lint-js workflows.
notes.stylelint: Kept because Whisk lint-styles calls the hoisted Stylelint binary with Core's shared config.
notes.stylelint-config-standard-scss: Kept because Core's Stylelint config extends the standard SCSS rules for Whisk lint-styles.
notes.stylelint-prettier: Kept because Core's Stylelint config loads Prettier checks for Whisk lint-styles.
notes.stylelint-selector-bem-pattern: Kept because Core keeps BEM selector lint support available to generated-theme lint-styles workflows.
notes.jest: Kept because Whisk test, coverage, and twatch call the hoisted Jest binary with Core's shared config.
notes.jest-environment-jsdom: Kept because Core's Jest config uses jsdom for Whisk test, coverage, and twatch.
notes.@babel/core: Kept because Core's ESLint and Jest Babel paths require Babel core for Whisk lint-js and tests.
notes.@babel/eslint-parser: Kept because Core's ESLint config uses the Babel parser for Whisk lint-js.
notes.@babel/preset-env: Kept because Core's Jest transform uses the env preset for Whisk tests.
notes.babel-preset-minify: Kept because Core ships a Babel minify config for generated-theme build tooling.
notes.open-cli: Kept because Whisk coverage opens the generated coverage report through the hoisted open-cli binary.
notes.pa11y: Kept because Whisk a11y runs Core's accessibility script, which imports Pa11y.
notes.axe-core: Kept because Core's Storybook preview and a11y tooling use axe rules for Whisk Storybook and a11y scripts.
notes.sass: Kept because Whisk Vite and Storybook scripts compile Sass through Core's shared tooling.
notes.postcss: Kept because Whisk Vite and Storybook scripts process CSS through Core's shared PostCSS tooling.
notes.postcss-scss: Kept because Core's Stylelint config parses SCSS for Whisk lint-styles.
notes.autoprefixer: Kept because Core's PostCSS config loads Autoprefixer for Whisk Vite and Storybook CSS output.
notes.normalize.css: Kept because verified Compound and Emulsify UI Kit consumers import normalize.css from SCSS compiled by Core scripts.
